tasks.title: Variable
tasks.statement: Create a variable year with the value 1991 (the year Python appeared) and print its value with print.

tasks.title: Value types
tasks.statement: Print, one per line, the type names of the values 5, 2.5, "привет" and True (in that order): int, float, str, bool. Get them with the type function instead of typing the words by hand.
tasks.hint: print(type(5).__name__), and the same for each value.

tasks.title: Condition
tasks.statement: Write a function parity(n) that returns the string «чётное» if n is divisible by 2 with no remainder, and «нечётное» otherwise.

tasks.title: Loop
tasks.statement: Print the numbers from 1 to 5, each on its own line, using a for loop (writing five print lines is not allowed: the output must come from a loop).

tasks.title: Function
tasks.statement: Write a function circle_area(r) that returns the area of a circle of radius r: 3.14 * r * r.

tasks.title: Class
tasks.statement: Define a class Dog: when you create Dog("Рекс"), it stores the name, and the method speak() returns the string «Рекс: гав» (with the name substituted). Print nothing: the checker will call your class itself.
tasks.hint: Store self.name in __init__; in speak return f"{self.name}: гав".
